verdict.rationale: The v3 agent docs say developers can customize the agent "by specifying the LLM provider and model," which implies some provider choice. That is a single thin mention, scoped to the v3 `agent` primitive, and nothing in the pack shows model-agnosticism across v4's act/extract/observe. missing for 10: a list of supported providers, custom or self-hosted model endpoint configuration, v4 documentation of model selection across all primitives, independent or hands-on corroboration of using non-default providers.
